journey.name: transfer banner opens progress
journey.description:
Verifies that tapping the "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner on Home reopens the "Funds in transfer" screen of the pending transfer to spending at its current step, also after a relaunch. A Later transfer keeps its deposit pending until 3 confirmations, so the banner stays up while the journey taps it.
Precondition: a Debug build with Spark connected on its regtest, launched against that regtest's Esplora (as spark-transfer-to-spending.xml sets up), a wallet with a positive confirmed on-chain Savings balance, no pending transfer, and at least one activity so Home shows its activity list. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the Savings balance card (id "ActivitySavings"), then "Transfer To Spending" (id "TransferToSpending"); tap "Get Started" (id "SpendingIntro-button") if the intro appears
Tap "Later" (id "SpendingConfirmLater") and swipe the "Swipe To Transfer" handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right
Verify the "Funds in transfer" screen (id "LightningSettingUp") opens, then tap "Continue Using Bitkit" (id "TransferSuccess-button")
Verify Home shows the "TRANSFER IN PROGRESS" banner (id "ActivityBanner")

Tap the banner and verify "Funds in transfer" (id "LightningSettingUp") opens at its current step: "Processing Payment", or "Payment Successful" once Spark lists the deposit, with "This should take about 30 minutes." (id "SettingUpText")
Go back and verify the wallet home screen shows with the banner still visible
Relaunch the app, tap the banner and verify the same screen and step open again
Mine 3 blocks on the regtest and wait until the screen shows the transfer as done (id "TransferSuccess"); tap its button and verify Home no longer shows the banner
